name: Seven-Point
description: Plan the ending first, then the turns that get you there: seven points from hook to resolution.

acts.title: Beginning
acts.description: The starting state and the call to change it.

beats.name: Hook
beats.hint: The starting state, ideally the opposite of where the story ends.

beats.name: Plot Turn 1
beats.hint: Something new enters and sets the story in motion.

acts.title: Middle
acts.description: Pressure, a turn from reaction to action, more pressure.

beats.name: Pinch 1
beats.hint: Pressure from the antagonist forces the protagonist to act.

beats.name: Midpoint
beats.hint: The protagonist stops reacting and starts acting.

beats.name: Pinch 2
beats.hint: More pressure: a loss or setback that leaves them alone.

acts.title: End
acts.description: The final piece falls into place.

beats.name: Plot Turn 2
beats.hint: The protagonist gets the last thing they need to win.

beats.name: Resolution
beats.hint: The climax and its outcome, the mirror of the Hook.
